title: FUEL R WING TK PUMP LO PR

ewdText: R WING TK PUMP LO PR

announce: ECAM, fuel, right wing tank pump, low pressure.

actions.say: Affected right wing tank pump, off.
Confirm the remaining right tank pump is on and feeding.

status: Status. One right wing tank pump lost; the tank still feeds on the remaining pump or by gravity.
No fuel is trapped; monitor the fuel page and the right engine feed.
Consider the crossfeed if a further pump is lost.
